item.text: {"formal_eligible":false,"transcript_id":"T1","contribution_units":8,"items":[{"question_index":1,"normalized_contribution":"本次产品范围仅限 personal_assistant，coding_cli 保持不变。","owner_atoms":["O01"]},{"question_index":1,"normalized_contribution":"统一选择的模型仅用于 PA 的自动工具权限分类；普通 Agent 请求及工具执行后的续跑仍使用当前 run 模型。","owner_atoms":["O04"]},{"question_index":2,"normalized_contribution":"自动工具权限分类所显式选择的模型在语义上必须与 llm.default_model 解耦。","owner_atoms":["O02"]},{"question_index":2,"normalized_contribution":"未显式配置审批模型时保留现状，使用触发分类的 Agent/run 模型。","owner_atoms":["O04"]},{"question_index":3,"normalized_contribution":"显式审批模型失败时不得静默回退到当前 Agent/run 模型、默认模型或其他模型。","owner_atoms":["O05"]},{"question_index":3,"normalized_contribution":"可以继续用同一个显式审批模型执行现有重试；重试仍失败后进入既有权限失败处理。","owner_atoms":["O08"]},{"question_index":4,"normalized_contribution":"显式审批模型不在 PA 模型目录中时，应视为 Gateway 启动配置错误，明确报错且配置不得生效。","owner_atoms":["O03"]},{"question_index":5,"normalized_contribution":"本期不支持该配置热加载；配置修改在 Gateway 重启后生效。","owner_atoms":["O06"]}]}
